Quiet, Comfortable and Convenient
I'm very familiar with the momcozy brand and have previously used several models of their breast pumps so I was very keen to try the V1 Pro and see how it compared to others. My first impression was that it felt like a really well made pump and it comes nicely presented in the box.You get two pumps which is ideal as you can use both at the same time. I found the initial setup fairly straightforward although choosing the right flange size is important. The sizing guide included is useful for helping you work out which one you need.I really like the wearable design as the collectors sit inside the bra and don t feel as bulky as I expected. The controls are easy to get to when you want to change the settings but can also be tucked away when you re up and about.There are different modes and suction levels to choose from so you can adjust it to whatever feels most comfortable for you. I was also pleasantly surprised by how quiet it is when running.The clear cups are u

seful too, as you can actually see how much you ve collected without having to remove them. Overall, I think Momcozy have done a good job with this one. It s well designed, easy enough to set up and the hands free aspect makes it much more convenient to use.
